newsitem.title: USA: North America bunkers down, but bouncing back up.
newsitem.headline: North America bunkers down, but bouncing back up.

text.p: North American bunker prices began to bounce back up on Thursday after scraping the bottom earlier this week, helped up by the slight rebound abroad and some supply tightness.
"I thing people sold out of supply when the market was dropping and that's helped get us going back up again," said one East Coast trader.
The market dropped after ARA and Singapore bunkers plunged amid ample supply and lack of buyers.
New York Harbor 380 CST traded between $101 and $103 a tonne, down $6 from Tuesday but above Wednesday levels.
